when_to_use: modal jazz over a static Dorian vamp, brushed floating swing, statement-rest-development melody, 100-125 BPM; optional pianoless counterpoint arrangement

defaults.feel: brushed swing, floating and gently behind the beat, no hard accents

signature_moves: So What voicing on Dm7: stacked 4ths E-A-D-G capped with a top major 3rd (B)
modal stepwise shift: D Dorian (Dm7) -> Eb Dorian (Ebm7), a half-step up for the bridge
minor stepwise cell: Dm7 (D Dorian) -> Em7 (E Phrygian/Dorian)
optional pianoless counterpoint variant: omit piano and use two independent horn lines (guide tones plus low counter-melody) over the same modal form
cadence_options: no functional cadence needed - a modal section shifts to the next mode or returns to the top
bridge resolution: the half-step-up mode returns directly to the home Dorian rather than using a dominant-tonic cadence
avoid: fast ii-V-I chord changes - harmony is a static canvas for melodic exploration (see cool-modal-jazz-genre.md SS3)
comping a chord on every beat - use sparse interactive punctuation instead

hook_archetypes.name: three-note-motif
hook_archetypes.rhythm: a simple 3-note statement, then 1-2 bars of silence, then the motif returns with rhythmic displacement or one changed final note
hook_archetypes.contour: stays within the mode's characteristic color, such as the natural 6th in Dorian
hook_archetypes.first_appears: Head, stated by the lead horn alone over the bass pedal

hook_archetypes.name: guide-tone-line
hook_archetypes.rhythm: long held notes tracing the mode's guide tones
hook_archetypes.contour: smooth, minimal movement - a line meant to be sung, not run through quickly
hook_archetypes.first_appears: Intro, over the bass pedal point before the full head enters

intro-pedal.note_lengths: very sparse - the bass pedal carries the section almost alone
intro-pedal.contour: a bare guide-tone fragment from the lead

head.note_lengths: short 2-3 note statements followed by 1-2 bars of rest
head.contour: unison or simple two-part counterpoint between horns, calm and unhurried
head.placement: close to the grid, expression carried by tone quality rather than timing

solo.note_lengths: motivic development - repeat and vary a short motif rather than running scales continuously
solo.contour: explores the mode's characteristic color at length, not chord outlining
solo.placement: close to the grid, comping sparse and reactive underneath

outro.note_lengths: the head motif repeats and thins out
outro.contour: morendo, ending on a suspended Harmon-muted note
outro.placement: relaxes further as the piece fades

drum_skeleton.low_energy: continuous brushed swish, feathered kick barely audible, soft pedal hi-hat on 2 and 4
drum_skeleton.mid_energy: brush swish slightly more present, occasional soft ride accent, still no hard hits
drum_skeleton.high_energy: within the 100-125 BPM range, brushes become more active and ride accents answer the horns, but drums remain unaccented; energy increases through contrapuntal horn activity, not harder hits

arrangement_defaults.layout_rules: bass pedal and brushes open; piano adds sparse So What voicings; the head uses unison or light horn counterpoint over the static mode; the bridge shifts a half-step up; solos develop motifs with sparse interactive comping; the optional pianoless variant removes piano but keeps the same form and uses two independent horn lines; the outro reduces the head motif to one suspended muted note

anti_boredom_rules: leave 1-2 bars of real silence after short melodic statements
harmony stays modal/static within a section - the sanctioned harmonic event is the half-step mode shift at the bridge
piano comping, when present, stays sparse and interactive
the three-note motif returns with rhythmic displacement or a changed final note, never identically
drums remain brushed and floating throughout the stated 100-125 BPM range

bass_behavior.role: modal pedal and sparse melodic anchor
bass_behavior.rhythmic_relationship: sits slightly behind the brushed pulse and avoids functional walking pressure
bass_behavior.density: sparse pedal in the head, selectively more active in solos
bass_behavior.articulation: warm upright sustain with ample decay

groove_intent.feel: floating brushed modal swing with no hard backbeat
groove_intent.snare: continuous brush texture rather than discrete backbeats
groove_intent.hihat: soft foot close on beats 2 and 4
groove_intent.ensemble_relationship: space and horn counterpoint create energy while rhythm section stays restrained

distinguishing_traits: static Dorian canvas instead of functional harmony
medium-tempo brushed ensemble with optional pianoless counterpoint
